title: NIST WebBook: Iodine is I2, molecular weight 253.80894 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Iodine as I2, molecular weight 253.80894 amu, CAS 7553-56-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Iodine, CAS Registry Number 7553-56-2, lists molecular formula I2 and molecular weight 253.80894 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 253.808946 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/I2/c1-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
